answer: A farm cannot fake the aggregate without controlling every key it names, as a result paying the lagoon bond on all of them and exposing each to the timber slash. Because the forge audit verifies the aggregate, a single forged member invalidates the whole batch. Attestations are aggregated into one signature over 7 distinct keys, and the aggregate must verify against each key's registered public value. Slashing removes 20 percent at once. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
